tooltips.complianceStatus: Measured against the requirements of this person's own role. Client and job requirements are checked when a shift or placement is confirmed.
tooltips.privacyNoticeDate: The date this person received your collection notice.
tooltips.marketingConsentDate: Send marketing only while this date is filled in. Clear it when consent is withdrawn.
tooltips.retentionReviewDate: When to review whether this record is still needed.
tooltips.workOnRecordUntil: The last day of work the retention hold counts from, kept if that work is later cancelled, moved or deleted.

messages.rxCandidateRoleLocked: A candidate's role sets what they must hold, so only a manager can change it. Ask a manager to update this record.
